description: Architecture explores how buildings shape the places we live — sustainable design and reuse, how architects work with clients and builders, measured drawings, and careers in architecture.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Excerpts confirmed requirements 1, 3, 4 and 5; requirement 2 was not visible and is not outlined yet.

requirements.title: Buildings in your community
requirements.summary: Touring your community’s buildings, sketching one you admire, and sustainable architecture and building reuse.

requirements.title: Professional practice
requirements.summary: One option, such as reviewing models and drawings with an architect, visiting a construction site, or writing a short program for a client.

requirements.title: A measured drawing
requirements.summary: Measuring a room and drawing a scaled floor plan with walls, doors, windows and built-in furniture.

requirements.title: Architecture careers
requirements.summary: Architecture career options and the preparation one of them requires.
